title: Can I BEAT Table Tactics?
summary: Table Tactics (Steam demo): a turn-based, physics-driven strategy game on a kitchen-table diorama (coffee mug, fireplace in the background) vs the computer. Your units are green, enemies red; you defeat enemies by physically knocking them over (no health bars). Units: catapults shooting rolling marbles, archers with precise arrows (first-person aiming), knights that ram and leap after a knockdown, fire mage / grand fire mage (bombs), towers. Each knockdown earns a coin to buy units from the build menu. New enemies (purple blobs carrying meat, later a dragon) spawn every turn and march on your castle; 5 hits on the castle = loss. He wins the level, mostly by spamming the mage.
rules: Turn-based vs AI: on your turn select each unit (Tab cycles), move it within its movement circle, then attack (Attack/Move/Look/Jump/Cancel menu).
Physics combat: an enemy is defeated when it is physically knocked over; standing units are unharmed regardless of hits.
Units: Catapult (launches marbles that roll), Archer (aimed arrow, first-person view), Knight (rams nearby units; big jump after a knockout), Fire Mage / Grand Fire Mage (explosive bomb), Tower.
Each enemy knocked over = 1 coin; spend coins in the build menu on new units (locked if unaffordable).
New enemies spawn each turn and walk to your castle; if your castle is attacked 5 times you lose (hearts 5).
Camera: right-click look around, WASD/arrows move camera, Q/E elevation.
win_condition: Survive the waves / knock over all enemies to finish the level; lose if the castle takes 5 hits.
